summary: Frontend-only testing for STEP 1 Pipeline Dashboard at /dashboard. All 5 nav pills render & navigate correctly with active-yellow highlight on all routes. Today/Week/Month range switching updates KPIs, 7 stage cards (counts, kg, percent-of-total, progress bars) and recharts AreaChart (7 hourly / 7 daily / 30 date buckets). Mobile layout (420px) collapses KPI to 2-col, stages to 1-col, and HeaderNav labels hidden (icons only). No regressions on /, /production, /courier, /admin.
critical_code_review_comments: PipelineDashboard.jsx month trend uses Math.random() at module load — values stable per page load but non-deterministic across refreshes (acceptable for mock data, but worth noting).
formatInt replaces ',' with '.' globally which works for Indonesian locale when toLocaleString returns commas; robust but would break if locale ever returned dot-thousands. Minor.

No data-testids exposed for individual KPI values (count vs label) — combined text-content scrape works for testing but finer selectors (e.g., kpi-total-orders-value) would aid future regression tests.
seed_data_creation: None — all data comes from client-side PIPELINE_DATA constant (mocked).
